note: D6 `pierce`, the lance key: the beam no longer stops on the first body, so the east cast from (2,4) walks all four tiles of its range - smokestack (3,4) for 2, the oil at (4,4) BEHIND it lit, smokestack (5,4) for 2, the oil at (6,4) behind THAT lit. Oil a machine is standing in front of is unlightable by any other card in the base pool, which is why this is a capability and not a number: solar_lance+noon on the same board deals its 4 to the first stack and ignites nothing past it (d6_forge_variant_a and d6_forge_variant_b are that contrast on one board). Drop the key - restore the `break` after the first enemy - and the second damage and both ignites are gone, so the record fails in plain mode. The FIRST cast is the other half of the rule: fired north into the smoke at (2,3), it stops dead and the smokestack at (2,2) takes nothing, because a blocks_beam tile still ends the walk exactly as a wall does; an event pattern cannot assert an absence, so that half rides on the state hash (REGRESS_STRICT=1) and on the note
